name: Luke’s Chunky Beef Marinara Sauce

items: Cooked ground beef, in desired portions

steps.title: Cook the onion and garlic
steps.body: Heat in a saucepan over medium-high heat: **2 Tbsp olive oil**. Add and cook 2-4 minutes until crisp-tender, stirring frequently: **1 onion, chopped** and **1 clove garlic, chopped**.

steps.title: Add the tomatoes
steps.body: Mix in, and bring to a boil: **14.5 oz peeled and diced tomatoes**, **15 oz tomato sauce**, **1 tsp white sugar**, **1 tsp dried oregano**, **¼ tsp salt**, pinch of rosemary and cooked ground beef, in desired portions.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Reduce heat to low and simmer 15-20 minutes or until flavors blended, stirring frequently.

yields: About 3½ cups sauce, enough for about 1 lb pasta (estimated)
